about: The run colour's and the run half's forming-bar sentences derive the server's reason from formingReason.js, as the runtime document's does (#2411; found by Deepvue). Each call site handing its ids (FE-M1, FE-M4), each sentence deriving rather than fixing the reason (FE-M2, FE-M3), the accessor (FE-M5) and the run half's forming branch (FE-M6).

mutants.mutant: the run colour's door hands its sentence no ids (every forming refusal says the fail-closed words)
mutants.from: const said = runtimeColourWhy(code, { formingIds: runtimeFormingIdsOf({ source: rc && rc.source }) })

mutants.mutant: the run colour's sentence says barstate whatever the server named (the defect)
mutants.from: return `this script ${formingReasonOf(formingIds)}, which has only been checked against TradingView on finished bars, `
mutants.to: return `this script ${formingReasonOf(['realtime-state'])}, which has only been checked against TradingView on finished bars, `

mutants.mutant: the run half's sentence says barstate whatever the server named (the defect)
mutants.from: return `the script ${formingReasonOf(formingIds)}, which has only been checked `
mutants.to: return `the script ${formingReasonOf(['realtime-state'])}, which has only been checked `

mutants.mutant: the binder's run-half note hands its sentence no ids
mutants.from: return runHalfRefusedSentence(runHalf.code, { formingIds: runtimeFormingIdsOf({ source: runHalfSourceOf(def) }) })

mutants.mutant: the accessor forgets the latched ids
the run half's forming code falls through to the generic sentence
